fetched_by: browser text fetch of the Exophase trophy page (page crawled less than a minute before that time)
note: Rates are in the order of the 55 trophies in the kit case files (id 1 platinum first). The text fetch did not expose the players-tracked header, so no players count is recorded here; do not invent one. Launch-night rates are the last read of practice case p00 (slot 2026-11-19T02:30:00Z, 638 players tracked). main.py uses this file only as a weak prior slope when a case's own history has too few distinct reads to fit a trend; when the case history is informative the prior weight is ~0.
refresh: To refresh: re-open https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/ , read the 55 rates in page order, replace snapshot_rates and fetched_at above, then re-run the local validation (see README.md). The program itself forecasts from the case history given at grading time; this file is only a prior.
